name: @imsweb/api
description: IMSWeb Hono API for Node and Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:server
scripts.syntax:node: pnpm run typecheck:server && pnpm run typecheck:worker && node --check js/server.js
scripts.syntax:scripts: node --check scripts/build/build-client.js && node --check scripts/build/build-server.js && node --check scripts/build/check-client.js && node --check scripts/build/check-worker-bundle.js && node --check scripts/checks/hono-architecture.js && node --check scripts/migration/chronicle-meta-to-d1.js && node --check scripts/migration/d1-reconcile.js && node --check scripts/migration/export-self-test.js && node --check scripts/migration/r2-manifest.js && node --check scripts/migration/r2-transfer.js && node --check scripts/migration/r2-transfer-transports.js && node --check scripts/migration/self-test.js && node --check scripts/migration/sqlite-to-d1.js && node --check scripts/migration/validate-migrations.js && node --check scripts/migration/wiki-media-sync.js && node --check scripts/operations/accounts/add-user.js && node --check scripts/operations/accounts/hash-password.js
scripts.syntax: pnpm run syntax:node && pnpm run syntax:scripts
scripts.check:migrations: node scripts/migration/validate-migrations.js && node scripts/migration/export-self-test.js && node scripts/migration/self-test.js && node scripts/migration/d1-reconcile.js migrations/fixtures/reconciliation-legacy.json migrations/fixtures/reconciliation-d1.json migrations/fixtures/critical-fields.json && node scripts/migration/d1-reconcile.js migrations/fixtures/reconciliation-story-legacy.json migrations/fixtures/reconciliation-story-d1.json migrations/fixtures/reconciliation-config.json
scripts.worker:dry-run: pnpm run build && pnpm run check:worker-bundle
scripts.check: pnpm run build:server && pnpm run syntax && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run check:assets && pnpm run check:migrations && pnpm run check:worker-bundle
scripts.test:node: pnpm run build:server && node --test tests/hono-app-contract.test.js tests/node-listener-probe.test.js tests/node-security.test.js tests/operation-scripts.test.js
scripts.test:wiki: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tests/wiki/tsconfig.json --noEmit && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.server.json node --import tsx --test tests/wiki/*.test.ts
scripts.test:server: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tests/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.server.json node --import tsx --test tests/server/*.test.ts
scripts.test:worker: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tests/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.test:migration: node --test tests/assets/client-allowlist.test.js tests/migration/chronicle-meta-import.test.js tests/migration/d1-reconcile.test.js tests/migration/r2-manifest.test.js tests/migration/r2-transfer.test.js tests/migration/wiki-media-sync.test.js tests/migration/wrangler-d1-import.test.js
scripts.test:fast: pnpm run check && pnpm run test:node && pnpm run test:server && pnpm run test:wiki && pnpm run test:migration && pnpm run test:worker
